description: This Java class defines a collection of public static final constants used as web-related constants in the OpenMRS project, specifically within the web package. It includes session attribute names, configuration parameters, URL paths, and other static identifiers relevant for web application functionality.

classes.name: WebConstants
classes.description: A utility class containing static final constants for web session attributes, configuration parameters, and URLs used across the OpenMRS web application.
